newsitem.title: USA: Grist Mill sees further efficiency gains.
newsitem.headline: Grist Mill sees further efficiency gains.

text.p: Grist Mill Co said Thursday it made progress in the fiscal third quarter to lower costs and expects to see gradual improvements in production efficiencies in the future.
Earlier, Grist Mill reported third quarter earnings of $0.08 a share, even with a year ago. For the nine-month period, earnings were $0.24 a share, down from $0.36 last year.
Grist Mill makes store brand and value-priced branded food products, including ready-to-eat cereals, fruit snacks, granola and other snack bars, and pie crusts.

"Our primary focus continues to be on the growth of our store brand grocery business," Glen Bolander, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "Sales in this area have grown 40 percent over the prior year reflecting our fast growing ready-to-eat cereal (up 52 percent) and wholesome snack bar (up 66 percent) businesses."

Contract manufacturing sales, reflecting product made on behalf of a customer, declined 17 percent form the previous year. Bolander said Grist Mill's largest contract customer, which was not named, reduced its orders.
